text: To story-engine's question: in Brave Bora the monkey is named in the text but never speaks; in Amahle the teddy is named once ('read to Teddy') and never speaks; in Catch That Cat the dog is never in the text at all. So the companion's text role was minimal or nil — the mirroring was carried by the pictures. Content-library's text form (a short 'mirror' line where the companion stops and relaxes with the child, without talking the tension away) translates that to text-only stories.
